name: Vajra (Diamond, Heerak) Bhasma

sections.overview: Vajra (Diamond, Heerak) Bhasma – Benefits, Usage, Indications and Dosage
sections.introduction:
Vajra Bhasma is also known as Heerak Bhasma is a formulation of Diamonds. It is a carbon based medicine. There are other elements other than diamond which are present in a smaller quantity because of its processing in an iron container. This formulation acts as a rejuvenator, a nutritious tonic, aphrodisiac. It aids in strengthening the heart and the entire body. Heerak Bhasma is an excellent medicine to cure cardiac ailments by eradicating the hindrances in the coronary arteries, provides relief in Angina pectoris, eases the contraction of veins and blood clotting and enhances the blood circulation. 
 Also, it helps in keeping equilibrium of the three Doshas.
sections.ingredients:
Purified diamond 

 Method of Preparation 
 Grind equal quantities of purified diamond along with Ras sindoor and purified sulphur. Put it in a container and seal it properly and heat it at a high temperature of 800- 900 Celsius. Let it cool down and then repeat the same process for 14 times to get the final product.
sections.dosage:
It should be consumed in a very small amount, 5- 8 mg twice a day after meals. 
 It can be taken with butter, clarified butter, milk or honey.

Over dosage should be avoided and might cause severe gastritis.

fullContent:
Vajra (Diamond, Heerak) Bhasma – Benefits, Usage, Indications and Dosage 
 Reference: Rasa Tarangini 
 Introduction 
 Vajra Bhasma is also known as Heerak Bhasma is a formulation of Diamonds. It is a carbon based medicine. There are other elements other than diamond which are present in a smaller quantity because of its processing in an iron container. This formulation acts as a rejuvenator, a nutritious tonic, aphrodisiac. It aids in strengthening the heart and the entire body. Heerak Bhasma is an excellent medicine to cure cardiac ailments by eradicating the hindrances in the coronary arteries, provides relief in Angina pectoris, eases the contraction of veins and blood clotting and enhances the blood circulation. 
 Also, it helps in keeping equilibrium of the three Doshas. 
 Ingredients 
 
 Purified diamond 
 
 Method of Preparation 
 Grind equal quantities of purified diamond along with Ras sindoor and purified sulphur. Put it in a container and seal it properly and heat it at a high temperature of 800- 900 Celsius. Let it cool down and then repeat the same process for 14 times to get the final product. 
 Dosage 
 
 It should be consumed in a very small amount, 5- 8 mg twice a day after meals. 
 It can be taken with butter, clarified butter, milk or honey. 
 
 Indications 
 
 Diabetes 
 Respiratory ailments 
 Liver disorders 
 Anemia 
 Ascites 
 Obesity 
 Cancer 
 Arthritis 
 Inflammation 
 Eye diseases 
 Impotency 
 Tuberculosis 
 Cardiac disorders 
 Enhances libido 
 
 Contraindications 
 
 Over dosage should be avoided and might cause severe gastritis. 
 It should be taken for a short duration. 
 Self-medication is discouraged and should be taken under medical supervision only. 
 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
